books.title: The Little Prince

books.description: A poetic tale about a young prince who visits various planets, learning about life and love.

books.title: Don Quixote
books.author: Miguel de Cervantes
books.description: The classic tale of a Spanish gentleman who becomes a knight-errant after reading too many chivalric romances.

books.title: The Three Musketeers
books.author: Alexandre Dumas
books.description: The adventures of a young man named d'Artagnan who travels to Paris to join the Musketeers.

books.title: The Metamorphosis
books.author: Franz Kafka
books.description: The story of Gregor Samsa who wakes up transformed into a giant insect.

books.title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
books.author: Lewis Carroll
books.description: A young girl named Alice falls through a rabbit hole into a whimsical underground world filled with peculiar creatures.

books.title: Pride and Prejudice
books.author: Jane Austen
books.description: A witty tale of love and social standing in Regency-era England, following the spirited Elizabeth Bennet.

books.title: A Study in Scarlet
books.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
books.description: Dr. Watson meets the brilliant detective Sherlock Holmes and they investigate a mysterious murder in London.

books.title: Oliver Twist

books.description: An orphan boy named Oliver endures hardship in Victorian London before discovering kindness and his true identity.
